notes: filenameTrigger (line 70) only seeds a default of "manual" from the `_manual_` token; the sidecar assignment block (lines 82-88) unconditionally overwrites triggerReason (and slotId/slotName/serverId/serverDisplayName) whenever readBackupMeta succeeds. isAutomatic (AppModels.swift:240) is derived from the FINAL triggerReason string, so a manually-tokened file whose sidecar says "pre-restore" correctly reports isAutomatic == false -- the sidecar, not the filename, is authoritative.
